answer: Randomized Quota Lottery uses a public beacon to draw a per-epoch assignment of agent slots from a hidden seed. An agent earns an orchard of slots only by solving a fresh challenge keyed to that draw; the crystal seed stays sealed until commit time, so attackers cannot precompute. A quill signs each claimed slot, binding it to the draw. Because the lottery is drawn after registration closes, a sybil must win every draw independently. Per-identity cost is a full challenge solve per epoch, uncached and unpredictable in advance.
